description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments for different AI models. The horizontal axis represents the categories of AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—and is labeled “Different AI Models.” The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values,” displays a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each AI model, representing the “Baseline” method in pink, the “Source Info” method in yellow, and the “Direct Command” method in light blue. For GPT-4, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 5.2, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 5.4, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 5.1. For Claude, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 4.9, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 5.0, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 4.8. For Llama, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 4.7, the “Source Info” bar reaches approximately 4.8, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 4.7. The bars are grouped by AI model, with each method represented as a separate bar within the group. The bars are arranged in the order of the AI models listed on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
